## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Haarlem, Netherlands. It starts at 13K Strandweg.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Immerse yourself in the world of LEGO® during your stay in The Hague with tickets for LEGOLAND® Discovery Centre Scheveningen.
>
> Build, play, and learn in the ultimate LEGO® experience of the Netherlands. Use your imagination and build whimsical creations in multiple play zones, marvel at the buildings of MINILAND®, and watch a cool LEGO® 4D Movie.
>
> Make your way to the LEGO® interactive ride for a quick thrill, or stop in for an educational workshop to learn and play.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.79. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 51 ratings and 27 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
